title: tc-correction-propagation
description:
How far a correction reaches: every artifact and released package that cites the corrected claim, each sent for
review – nothing rewritten automatically.

heading.description: The heading, and the component's name

claim.description: The claim as it was, before the correction

meta.description: Who corrected it and when, as one line – e.g. "Dana Okafor · today, 10:42"

candidates.description: The artifacts and released packages that cite the corrected claim

states.description: Each item's state by id; an item not named here uses its own `state`, else "pending". Changed by the user unless a tc-states-change listener calls preventDefault()

note.description: The line under the list – what the component won't do

emptyText.description: Shown when nothing cites the claim

title.description: What it is – e.g. "Board summary, slide 3"

kind.description: "package" for something already released to others (it can't be changed, only superseded); "artifact" (default) for a working document

detail.description: One quieter line – where it cites the claim, who owns it

quote.description: The passage that cites the corrected claim

state.description: The state it starts in, when `states` doesn't name it
